# Native-v17 final-clear calibration

All card readers, ordinary scene evidence and dialogue data retain exact native-v16
values. Removing board.final_clear and restoring profile_id recreates the entire
[previous profile](../native-v16/profile.json). Original v16 files are untouched.

The six source image/deal files are byte-exact copies of two exposed116 failure
packets; provenance.json records original paths and hashes. The later clear frames
show Perfect with Score1280/2900 and2570/2900, not complete challenge victories.
Earlier frames remain animated refusal regressions. No image was retouched.

Final-only proof requires all28 top60x4 bands entirely satisfying unchanged felt,
all3 marker patches, original chart anchors and exact expected pile faces. The
measured empty LEFT circle can replace DRAW only with modelled empty LEFT and its
positive empty face. Marker masks retain at least80% (3073/3584,3178/3840,3465/3780),
excluding only channel differences>4 between the two originals; complete source
RGB is retained. Tolerance<=4, existing contrast64 and patch4096 limits apply.
No glyph threshold, bank, alignment, colour or ambiguity policy changed.

Tests use grey/erased/title-damaged/retained-apex derivatives solely for refusal.
The capture-adapter normal-header composition is synthetic and supplies no missing
normal ordinal calibration, guest receipt or live acceptance. Perfect never supplies
challenge-completion or restart authority. See [verification](../../../../docs/Verification-2.6.117.md).
